state_profile.voting_summary: Michigan now offers 9 days of early voting and no-excuse mail voting, and a 2022-24 reform lets cities pre-process absentee ballots for 8 days before the election, Detroit reported over 80% of its absentee vote by late evening in 2024, ending the multi-day waits of 2020. Polls close at 9 p.m. Eastern; pre-processed absentee and early votes are released alongside election day precincts through the night, and the state is effectively complete by the following morning. Mail ran D+29 against R+14 on election day, so Democratic-leaning absentee batches land through the night rather than days later.
